title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: How do you make a pancake?
First, mix the flour with some milk.
sentences.zh: 首先，把面粉和牛奶混合。

sentences.en: Pour the mixture into a hot pan.
Cut the pumpkin into small pieces.
Stir-fry it in oil for five minutes.
Add a little pepper and cheese.
Put the pie into the oven and bake it.
According to the recipe, we need two spoons of sugar.
sentences.zh: 根据食谱，我们需要两勺糖。

sentences.en: What a delicious meal this is!
